key_idea: Translating a putative matroid covering on a double ray into an impossible strictly descending infinite sequence of ordinal ranks derived from an ultrafilter.
reason: The core contradiction of forcing a strictly decreasing sequence of ordinals is a brilliantly unexpected and highly conceptual application of set theory to matroid theory. While constructing the specific matroid blocks demands dense technical machinery and transfinite recursion, the overarching argument remains clear and inevitable.
recognized: Counterexample to the Bowler-Carmesin infinite matroid packing/covering conjecture
